title: Subgaussian absolute tail bound
statement: Let $\nu$ be a probability measure on $\mathbb{R}$ whose moment-generating function satisfies the subgaussian bound with parameter $1$. For every $t\ge 0$, the measure of $\{x\in\mathbb{R}:t<|x|\}$ is at most $2e^{-t^2/2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $\nu$ has subgaussian moment-generating function with parameter $1$
